about.contact.description: Contact line; keep the <mail></mail> tags around {email}

about.honor.defaultMessage: Anyone can post — we trust our neighbors. If spam shows up, we’ll add a neighborhood code or sign-in. Kids are welcome to help with a grown-up’s OK.
about.honor.description: Explains open posting and what happens if it is abused

about.how.fed.defaultMessage: Fed King? Tap “I fed King”, pick what he ate, and log it.

about.how.undo.defaultMessage: Made a mistake? You can undo for 10 minutes.

about.purpose.defaultMessage: This site helps us share the job: when he last ate, what he had, and where he was last seen — so nobody has to guess.

about.story.defaultMessage: King is an 11-year-old grey long-haired cat. His owner left him behind two years ago, so the neighbors on his street decided to look after him together.
about.story.description: King’s story, first paragraph of the About page

app.name.description: Site name shown in the header

app.unreachable.defaultMessage: Couldn’t reach King’s tracker. Check your connection and try again.
app.unreachable.description: Shown when the status cannot be loaded

feed.atSpot.description: The feeding spot that will be logged; {spot} is its name. <change> becomes a button.

feed.hint.defaultMessage: Tap everything he had. Not sure? Just log it.
feed.hint.description: Explains that several foods can be picked, or none

feed.leftOut.defaultMessage: I left food out (didn’t see him)
feed.leftOut.description: Checkbox: the feeder put food out but did not see King, so it does not count as a sighting

feed.log.description: Saves the feeding with the picked foods

feed.noSpot.description: No feeding spot picked yet. <change> becomes a button.

footer.about.description: Footer link to the About page

footer.copyright.description: Copyright year for the site content

footer.credit.defaultMessage: Brought to you by King’s neighbors on Guy St.
footer.credit.description: Footer credit; Guy St. is the street name and stays as is

footer.privacy.description: Footer link to the Privacy page

footer.siteLinks.description: Accessible name for the footer link list

home.aNeighbor.description: Used as {name} when the reporter gave no name

home.atSpot.description: Activity detail; {spot} is the feeding spot’s name

home.fedAgo.description: Chip; {when} is e.g. “2 hours ago” or “just now”

home.fedAndSeenAgo.description: Single chip when the last feeding is also the last time King was seen; {when} is e.g. “2 hours ago”

home.fedBy.description: Activity item; {name} is who fed King

home.iFedKing.description: Big button to log a feeding

home.iSawKing.description: Big button to log a sighting

home.lately.description: Heading over the recent activity list

home.mapKey.description: Accessible name of the list explaining the map’s markers

home.mapTitle.description: Heading over the small home map, which shows only the latest feeding and sighting

home.mood.content.description: Heading when King was fed recently

home.mood.contentDetail.description: Playful royal line under the content heading

home.mood.hungry.description: Heading when King has not been fed for over 12 hours

home.mood.hungryDetail.description: Playful royal line under the hungry heading

home.nearSpot.description: Activity detail for a sighting within about a block of a saved feeding spot; {spot} is its name

home.notFed.description: Chip when no feeding has been logged

home.notSeen.description: Chip when no sighting has been logged

home.nothingYet.defaultMessage: Nothing logged yet. Be the first!
home.nothingYet.description: Shown when the activity list is empty

home.photoAlt.defaultMessage: King, a fluffy grey long-haired cat

home.seenBy.description: Activity item; {name} is who saw King

home.statusChips.description: Accessible name for the fed/seen chips

home.tagline.defaultMessage: A whimsical, neighborly way to keep track of King, the 11-year-old long-hair our neighborhood co-parents. Who saw him, where, and when he last ate.
home.tagline.description: One-line explanation of the site under the header on the home page

logged.fed.detail.defaultMessage: King was fed just now. Thank you!

logged.loggingAs.description: The name shown with this device’s entries; {name} is a nickname or “a neighbor”. <change> becomes a button.

logged.seen.detail.defaultMessage: Everyone can see he was spotted just now.

logged.undoExpired.defaultMessage: It’s too late to undo — entries can only be undone for 10 minutes.
logged.undoExpired.description: Shown when the server refuses an undo because the entry is older than 10 minutes

map.attribution.description: Required map data credit; {osm} is the “OpenStreetMap” link

map.useCenter.description: Picks the point under the cross in the middle of the map; the keyboard alternative to tapping it

nickname.hint.defaultMessage: A first name or nickname. Everyone can see it next to your entries.
nickname.hint.description: Explains what kind of name to give and that it is public

nickname.save.description: Keeps the typed name and carries on logging

nickname.skip.description: Carries on logging without a name

nickname.title.description: Heading of the one-time name question

page.backToKing.description: Link from About/Privacy back to the home page

place.back.description: Leave the place screen without choosing

place.locationFailed.description: The browser refused or could not find the device’s location

place.nearNow.description: Uses the device’s location for a sighting

place.useMyLocation.description: Uses the device’s location for a new spot

privacy.intro.defaultMessage: We keep as little as possible.
privacy.intro.description: Opening line of the Privacy page

privacy.not.fonts.defaultMessage: Our fonts are hosted here, so visiting doesn’t contact Google.

privacy.not.ip.defaultMessage: Your internet address is used for about a minute to stop spam (it limits how often entries can be posted) and isn’t stored. We remove it from our technical logs.
privacy.not.ip.description: IP addresses: used briefly for rate limiting, stripped from telemetry

privacy.not.maps.defaultMessage: Maps are the exception: the map pictures load from OpenStreetMap, which sees your internet address and which part of the map you’re looking at. See <policy>OpenStreetMap’s privacy policy</policy>.
privacy.not.maps.description: Third party: OpenStreetMap tile servers; keep the <policy></policy> tags around the link text

privacy.not.title.description: Heading over the list of things not collected

privacy.not.tracking.defaultMessage: No accounts, ads, trackers or cookies.
privacy.not.tracking.description: Not collected: accounts, ads, trackers, cookies

privacy.parents.defaultMessage: For parents: kids can help without sharing anything about themselves. If they’d like a name on their entries, help them pick a nickname instead of their real name.
privacy.parents.description: Note for parents about children using the site

privacy.retention.defaultMessage: Entries are kept as King’s history. Want one removed? Email <mail>{email}</mail>.
privacy.retention.description: Retention and removal requests; keep the <mail></mail> tags around {email}

privacy.stored.code.defaultMessage: A random code saved in your browser, so you can undo your own entries. It isn’t linked to who you are.
privacy.stored.code.description: Stored data: the per-device undo key

privacy.stored.events.defaultMessage: When King was fed or seen, what he ate, and the name you gave, if any.

privacy.stored.location.defaultMessage: Where King was, if you choose to say. It’s rounded to about a block before it leaves your browser, so we never get your exact spot. Your phone’s location is used only when you tap “I’m near him now” or “Use where I am”.
privacy.stored.location.description: Stored data: optional sighting places, rounded in the browser; when geolocation is used

privacy.stored.name.defaultMessage: Your name is optional, and everyone can see it next to your entries, so use a first name or nickname. Your browser remembers it, so you’re only asked once.
privacy.stored.name.description: Stored data: the optional public nickname, also kept in the browser

privacy.stored.spots.defaultMessage: Feeding spots neighbors add: a name and a place (also rounded), which everyone can see.
privacy.stored.spots.description: Stored data: shared feeding spots are public

privacy.stored.title.description: Heading over the list of stored data

seen.hint.defaultMessage: Helps neighbors know where he hangs out. We only keep it to about a block.
seen.hint.description: Why a place is asked for, and that it is rounded

seen.logHere.description: Logs the sighting at the place picked on the map

seen.mapLabel.defaultMessage: Map: tap where you saw King

seen.skip.description: Logs the sighting without a place

seen.title.description: Heading of the sighting place screen

spot.list.description: Accessible name of the list of saved feeding spots

spot.mapLabel.defaultMessage: Map: tap where you fed King

spot.nameHint.defaultMessage: Like “Blue house steps”. Everyone can see it, so leave out house numbers and family names.
spot.nameHint.description: Guidance for naming a spot without giving away who lives there

spot.nameLabel.description: Label of the new spot’s name field

spot.needNameAndPlace.defaultMessage: Give the spot a name and pick its place.
spot.needNameAndPlace.description: Shown when saving a new spot without a name or place

spot.new.description: Opens the form to add a new feeding spot

spot.none.description: Logs the feeding without a spot

spot.placeSet.description: Confirms a place was chosen for the new spot

spot.save.description: Adds the new spot and uses it for this feeding

spot.title.description: Heading of the feeding spot screen

time.justNow.description: Something happened less than a minute ago

title.about.description: Browser tab title of the About page

title.home.description: Browser tab title of the home page

title.privacy.description: Browser tab title of the Privacy page
